zh: 支持自定义打开任务看板的快捷键。
优化平板工具栏、侧边栏和搜索框，改善菜单关闭与卡片选择交互。
统一鼠标与触屏按压反馈，改善菜单提示与空分组操作。
Mermaid 代码块使用 Paseo 图表渲染，修复计划列表重复间距和滚动时的间距变化。
en: Configure a keyboard shortcut to open the Tasks board.
Refine tablet toolbars, sidebars and search fields, including menu dismissal and card selection.
Unify pointer and touch press feedback, and improve menu hints and empty-group actions.
Render Mermaid blocks with Paseo’s diagram renderer, and fix duplicate plan spacing and spacing changes while scrolling.
